title: Peas Wet: modeled ₹928/qtl left, Bhuntar → Palampur
summary: April 2022: reported peas Wet prices at Bhuntar and Palampur imply a positive modeled margin after costs on 100% of 24 matched days; a morning-report back-test averages ₹928 per quintal. No actual trade verified.
why_selected: Selected from 114 same-variety market pairs screened for peas Wet in April 2022; best tested candidate among the bounded set of routed finalists, not a global optimum.

evidence.observations: daily modal prices for the same variety and grade (FAQ) at both markets; sale matched to the first Palampur report 1–3 days after purchase
caveats: Back-test on reported prices: no actual shipment, buyer or seller is claimed.
Modal prices are reported daily aggregates, not offers anyone could be sure to get.
This data has no arrival volumes, so it cannot show whether the destination could absorb more supply; no capital-constrained or volume allocation optimum is claimed.

Costs extrapolate onion survey values (including to other crops) plus stated allowances, not freight quotes; OSRM car routing, not a verified truck route. Representative town points may not be at mandi gates.
Historical: this says what paid then, not what pays today.

scenes.headline: April 2022
scenes.caption: Bhuntar (Himachal Pradesh) and Palampur (Himachal Pradesh) both reported peas Wet prices for the same variety and grade (FAQ) on 24 matched days.

scenes.headline: Two markets, two prices
scenes.caption: Bhuntar reported a median ₹3,500 per quintal. Palampur reported a median ₹4,725 around modeled arrival days. These are not offers.

scenes.headline: Gap ₹1,425/qtl
scenes.caption: The median gap was ₹1,425 per quintal, and Palampur was dearer on 100% of days.

scenes.headline: 193 km by road
scenes.caption: 193 km on OpenStreetMap roads (~5 hours by car). A loaded truck is slower, so we allow 1 days plus 7 days to get paid.

scenes.headline: After modeled costs
scenes.caption: Freight ≈₹41/qtl, 5% fees and commission, loading, 5% loss and interest. On the typical day ₹885 per quintal was left.

scenes.headline: Still positive under stress
scenes.caption: With 25% dearer freight, 10% loss and costlier credit, the typical day still kept ₹585 per quintal.

scenes.headline: A trader who only knew the morning's news
scenes.caption: Using only the latest available Palampur report, the rule selects 21 of 24 modeled shipping days. 21 had positive modeled net, averaging ₹928 per quintal (₹666 under stress).

scenes.headline: The back-test
scenes.caption: The modeled Peas Wet route from Bhuntar to Palampur was positive on 100% of matched days in April 2022. At that average, a 100-quintal (10-tonne) load implies ₹92,800, or ₹66,600 under stress. Actual buyer, capacity, haggling, rejection and delays are unknown.

assumptions.value: onion survey freight applied per quintal to peas Wet
scaled by road km against the 1,115 km Lasalgaon→Azadpur route → ₹41/qtl here
12% a year (14% adverse) for transit + 7 days
~450 road km a day → 1 days here

conclusion: The modeled Peas Wet route from Bhuntar to Palampur was positive on 100% of matched days in April 2022. At that average, a 100-quintal (10-tonne) load implies ₹92,800, or ₹66,600 under stress. Actual buyer, capacity, haggling, rejection and delays are unknown.

title: Peas Wet: modeled ₹595/qtl left, Ladwa → Kangra (Baijnath)
summary: December 2022: reported peas Wet prices at Ladwa and Kangra (Baijnath) imply a positive modeled margin after costs on 96% of 26 matched days; a morning-report back-test averages ₹595 per quintal. No actual trade verified.
why_selected: Selected from 212 same-variety market pairs screened for peas Wet in December 2022; best tested candidate among the bounded set of routed finalists, not a global optimum.

evidence.observations: daily modal prices for the same variety and grade (FAQ) at both markets; sale matched to the first Kangra (Baijnath) report 1–3 days after purchase
caveats: Back-test on reported prices: no actual shipment, buyer or seller is claimed.
Modal prices are reported daily aggregates, not offers anyone could be sure to get.
This data has no arrival volumes, so it cannot show whether the destination could absorb more supply; no capital-constrained or volume allocation optimum is claimed.

Costs extrapolate onion survey values (including to other crops) plus stated allowances, not freight quotes; OSRM car routing, not a verified truck route. Representative town points may not be at mandi gates.
Historical: this says what paid then, not what pays today.

scenes.headline: December 2022
scenes.caption: Ladwa (Haryana) and Kangra (Baijnath) (Himachal Pradesh) both reported peas Wet prices for the same variety and grade (FAQ) on 26 matched days.

scenes.headline: Two markets, two prices
scenes.caption: Ladwa reported a median ₹2,250 per quintal. Kangra (Baijnath) reported a median ₹3,100 around modeled arrival days. These are not offers.

scenes.headline: Gap ₹850/qtl
scenes.caption: The median gap was ₹850 per quintal, and Kangra (Baijnath) was dearer on 100% of days.

scenes.headline: 315 km by road
scenes.caption: 315 km on OpenStreetMap roads (~5 hours by car). A loaded truck is slower, so we allow 1 days plus 7 days to get paid.

scenes.headline: After modeled costs
scenes.caption: Freight ≈₹68/qtl, 5% fees and commission, loading, 5% loss and interest. On the typical day ₹499 per quintal was left.

scenes.headline: Still positive under stress
scenes.caption: With 25% dearer freight, 10% loss and costlier credit, the typical day still kept ₹326 per quintal.

scenes.headline: A trader who only knew the morning's news
scenes.caption: Using only the latest available Kangra (Baijnath) report, the rule selects 25 of 26 modeled shipping days. 25 had positive modeled net, averaging ₹595 per quintal (₹424 under stress).
